seed_claims.claim: SEED §2: for SU(3) the Wess-Zumino term makes the fold a fermion when N_c is odd (Witten 1983)
seed_claims.evidence: Conditional on the WZ constraint Y_R = N_c B/3 (taken from Witten/DPP, not derived here): every allowed state has 2J = N_c mod 2 for N_c = 1..15 (p+q <= 30); lowest states listed for N_c = 1..7. E2 tests the group theory that follows from the rule, not the WZ mechanism

seed_claims.claim: SEED §4: in 3D a static fold cannot be held by gradient energy alone (Derrick); something must push back
seed_claims.evidence: E2[F(mu x)] = E2/mu exactly (quadrature, 2e-15); the sigma-model radial ODE has no solution reaching F = 0 (ends at pi/2); with the Skyrme term E2/E4 - 1 = -4.4e-13 (reference) and +5.6e-13 (independent quadrature), int p d^3x / int |p| d^3x = -6.8e-13

seed_claims.claim: SEED §6B: quantizing the hedgehog's rotations, the lowest states fill the octet and the decuplet (Guadagnini 1984)
seed_claims.evidence: Lowest allowed (Y_R = 1) states are 8 (J=1/2) and 10 (J=3/2), asserted by su3_rotor.py (the order depends only on I1/I2 = 2.62, so the two parameter sets are one test); the same rotor also predicts exotic 10bar (J=1/2) and 27 at E(8) + 3/(2I2) and above (about 1760 MeV at the SU(3) refit), which the seed does not mention

seed_claims.claim: SEED §6B: with exact SU(3) every member of a multiplet has one mass; the splittings need a symmetry-breaking term with more parameters
seed_claims.evidence: All d_R(2J+1) rotor states of 8, 10, 10bar are degenerate (explicit matrices). Optional first-order H' = -alpha D88 + beta Y needs 2 fitted inputs; it reproduces the 8 PDG multiplets with rms 4 MeV and implies GMO, equal spacing and Guadagnini's relation (PDG: +0.04%)

seed_claims.claim: SEED §6B: F sets the units and e is the only pure number, so every prediction is a ratio
seed_claims.evidence: M = 36.46 F_pi/e, I = coef/(e^3 F_pi), g_A = 18.09/e^2: every dimensionless observable is a function of e alone (massless pions, N_c fixed; a pion mass would add m_pi/(e F_pi)). True by construction (dimensional analysis)

seed_claims.claim: SEED §6B: for nucleons the model lands within roughly 30% (ANW 1983)
seed_claims.evidence: Masses are fit inputs. The one non-fit nucleon static property E2 computes, g_A = 0.61 vs |g_A/g_V| = 1.2753(13) (PDG 2026), is 52% low, outside 30%; in the SU(3)-symmetric rotor it drops further by 7/10. Whether the other static properties (radii, magnetic moments) land within 30% is E5's test; E2 does not assert it (reconciliation: the earlier 'most static properties within about 30%' clause is withdrawn here as not shown by E2). Context: the fitted F_pi = 129 MeV is 30.5% below 186 MeV if the masses are regarded as the inputs
